newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Four hurt in Christian-Moslem clash in Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Four hurt in Christian-Moslem clash in Pakistan.

text.p: At least four people were wounded when Christians and Moslems clashed in central Pakistan on Thursday, local officials said.

They said the trouble began on Wednesday night in Khanewal town, Punjab province, when pages torn from a holy Koran were thrown into a mosque in the Railway Colony district where Moslems were praying.
The torn pages carried the names of several Christians living in the town's mainly Christian Shantinagar area.

Moslems retaliated, setting fire to a church in Shantinagar. When Christians learned of the incident on Thursday morning they came to Shantinagar from nearby villages and battled Moslems who also had flocked to the scene.
Police said at least four people had been wounded in gunfire between the two groups, and that shooting was still going on.
Most of Pakistan's 131 million people are Moslems, but there is a small Christian minority.
